name: Sign-up form validates input and reports closed signups clearly

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/app, click 'New here? Create an account'
The sign-up form shows name, email and password fields plus a 'Create account' button
Submit the form with an invalid email like 'not-an-email' and a short password
A validation error appears and the user is not logged in
Submit with a well-formed email like qa.tester+ts@example.com and a 16-character password
Either signup succeeds into the app, or a clear alert message is shown explaining that sign-ups are closed on this deployment
